[batch narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] CyrusOne is a large scale data center provider headquartered in Dallas, Texas. In 2016 CyrusOne purchased the Chicago Mercantile Exchanges original Aurora, Illinois data center from CME Group for roughly 130 million dollars, with CME Group continuing to operate its Globex matching engine on site under a 15 year lease. In November 2021, KKR and Global Infrastructure Partners agreed to acquire CyrusOne in an approximately 15 billion dollar deal, taking the company private, and that acquisition closed in 2022. CyrusOne has operated as a privately held company since, a company level ownership fact this registry had not previously recorded with a citable source. This specific row, San Antonio III, is inferred to match this operators own SAT3 site code by sequential naming: this registrys separate San Antonio II row is directly confirmed to correspond to SAT2 by an aggregator listing title and this operators own now defunct website naming convention, and the operators own current locations page, fetched fresh this session, groups SAT2, SAT3, and SAT4 together as one named Data Center Campus. A datacentermap listing dedicated to SAT3, fetched fresh this session, gives 9554 Westover Hills Boulevard, San Antonio, Texas 78251 as the street address, the same address independently given on datacentermaps own dedicated SAT2 page, consistent with the two buildings sharing a campus entrance address. A separate datacenterHawk search result gave a slightly different house number, 9500 rather than 9554, for the same Westover Hills Boulevard street, a minor aggregator discrepancy this session did not resolve further but does not consider a blocking conflict given both aggregators agree on the same street, campus, and immediate vicinity.
